# Code of conduct

errbudget follows the
[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/)
in every project space: issues, pull requests, reviews and any other place where people
take part in the project. Report unacceptable behaviour to the maintainer, Gökberk
Kabacaoğlu, at <gokberk.kabacaoglu@durham.ac.uk>. Every report is reviewed and handled
confidentially, as the Covenant's enforcement guidelines describe.
